answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Reaching the meadow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The sable is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble.
